senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Lunar.
n. (-वं)
The asterism Mṛgaśiras.
f. (-वी)
A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
इन्दु the moon, अण् aff.

mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं)
Sacred, or relating to the god INDRA.
m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A name of the monkey king BĀLĪ.
2 A name of ARJUNA.
f. (-न्द्री)
1 The wife of INDRA.
2 The goddess DURGĀ.
3 Misfortune, misery, (personified.) The name of a plant, a kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
5 The constellation Jyeṣṭha.
6 The east quarter, of which INDRA is regent.
E.
इन्द्र, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Deceptive, illusory.
m. (-कः)
A juggler.
E.
इन्द्रजाल deception, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Afflicted with falling of the hair or morbid baldness.
E.
इन्द्रलुप्त falling of the hair, and ठक् aff.

m. (-ग्नः)
A ceremony, &c. addressed to INDRA and AGNI.
E.
इन्द्र, and अग्नि, with अण् aff.

mfn. (-धः-धी-धं)
Relating to INDRA'S bow or the rainbow.
E.
इन्द्रायुध, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Sacred to INDRA and VARUṆA.
E.
इन्द्र, and वरुण with अण् aff.

m. (-न्द्रिः)
1 The patronymick of JAYANTA the son of INDRA.
2 A name of the monkey BĀLĪ.
3 A name of ARJUNA.
4 A crow.
E.
इन्द्र, इञ् patronymick aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Perceptible, perceived, present.
2 Of or belonging to the sense.
E.
इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, and वुञ् aff.
